# What is your book of business worth, and is the offer fair?

> Free insurance agency book of business valuation calculator. Enter revenue, retention, servicing cost and the return you need, and see what the book is worth, compare a purchase offer with upfront and holdback, and find the break-even price. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
